items.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002
items.q: Fred Hirsch gave me that song.

ctx.x: Yeah? That’s a nice change here.

Oh yeah. What I did was I modulated. I made the head arrangement modulating it. Yeah. I love Kenny Barron, he’s just so wonderful. We worked — I have a few albums with him. I have one in Japan that I did. But I’ve been working more with Steve now again after — we had our group together for a while and then that sort of didn’t make it and then so we recorded with different people. And then I went back to Ken again. I think © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
he’s so underrated. He’s such a beautiful player. But no, I like that song. Fred Hirsch gave me that song.
